say:1:1610802002:0.text: Hurry up, you're the last one!
say:1:1610802002:0.male: Hurry up, you're the last one!
say:1:1610802002:0.female: Hurry up, you're the last one!

say:1:1610805001:1.text: I just get more nervous the closer we get... My palms are sweating, and my heart is racing!
say:1:1610805001:1.source_cn: 我……越临近考试我越觉得紧张，现在我的手出了好多汗，心...

choice_prompt:2:1610805001.text: I just get more nervous the closer we get... My palms are sweating, and my heart is racing!
choice_prompt:2:1610805001.source_cn: 我……越临近考试我越觉得紧张，现在我的手出了好多汗，心也在怦怦跳！

say:3:1610805002:0.text: Pippa, just breathe. You've got this. It'd be a shame to mess up just because you're panicking.
say:3:1610805002:0.source_cn: 皮帕，你别慌，深呼吸一下平复心情。要是因为紧张害怕而失...

say:4:1610805003:0.text: I... I just keep seeing the headmaster collapse.
say:4:1610805003:0.source_cn: 我、我脑子里总想着那天校长一下子倒在地上的情景。

say:5:1610805004:0.text: And that interrogation with Envoy Evie... She was polite, but I was still terrified.
say:5:1610805004:0.source_cn: 还有审查所的审讯……虽然伊芙特使态度很好，可我就是不由...

say:6:1610805005:1.text: I get it. I was right there when the headmaster fell.
say:6:1610805005:1.source_cn: 我理解……校长倒下的时候，我就在他身边。

say:7:1610805006:1.text: It's alright, guys. Nothing to worry about. Envoy Evie confirmed it had nothing to do with you. Just put it out of your mind.
say:7:1610805006:1.source_cn: 好了，休，皮帕，没事了。伊芙特使不是已经调查清楚了吗，...

say:8:1610805007:1.text: Don't get stuck being scared. Focus on today's exam.
say:8:1610805007:1.source_cn: 与其一直沉浸在恐慌里，不如想想今天的选拔赛。

say:9:1610805008:1.text: This is the last round of the preliminaries. Get through this, and you're in the finals. Don't lose your focus now.
say:9:1610805008:1.source_cn: 今天可是初赛的最后关卡了，只要通过就能晋级决赛，你们可...

say:10:1610805009:1.text: Hey, I heard a rumor today's test involves transfiguration!
say:10:1610805009:1.source_cn: 对了，我听说今天的选拔赛要用到变形术！

say:12:1610805010:1.text: Transfiguration? What does a court mage need that for?
say:12:1610805010:1.source_cn: 变形术？宫廷魔法师需要变形？

say:14:1610805011:1.text: Everyone, sorry to interrupt... the judges will be arriving shortly, so please gather over here first.
say:14:1610805011:1.source_cn: 各位，不好意思，打断一下……今天比赛的评委马上就要来了...

say:0:1610810001:0.text: This flying carpet is brilliant. I want one too...
say:0:1610810001:0.source_cn: 这飞毯可真有意思，我也想要一条……
say:0:1610810001:0.male: This flying carpet is brilliant. I want one too...
say:0:1610810001:0.female: This flying carpet is brilliant. I want one too...

say:3:1610812002:0.text: Professor! Are you judging the exam today?
say:3:1610812002:0.source_cn: 娑丽丝老师！今天是你做考试评委吗？

say:4:1610812003:0.text: Oh, no, not this time. The judges are Magister Cyran and Headmistress Durella. Professor Hepler and I are just here to keep things running smoothly—and to make sure everyone follows the rules, of course.
say:4:1610812003:0.source_cn: 不是的，评委当然还是迪尔格雷大人与杜瑞拉女士。我会和赫...

say:6:1610812004:0.text: Is the exam location right here?
say:6:1610812004:0.source_cn: 娑丽丝老师，考试地点就在这里吗？

say:7:1610812005:0.text: That's right. The entire forest is part of the exam grounds. We've even set up a little... surprise for you all out there. You'll see what I mean soon enough.
say:7:1610812005:0.source_cn: 整个空境森林都是考场，而且我们还设置了一个很特别的区域...

say:8:1610812006:0.text: If you have questions later, come find me after the exam. I'll be happy to explain everything then. For now, I'm afraid I can't spoil the surprise.
say:8:1610812006:0.source_cn: 各位同学，如果你们还有什么疑惑，可以在考试结束之后再来...

say:9:1610812007:0.text: Alright. Before we begin, there's a small magical aptitude test. Think of it as a warmup. Pass this, and you'll move on to the real thing.
say:9:1610812007:0.source_cn: 好了，在正式考试之前，你们还要进行一个魔法能力测试，通...

choice_prompt:10:1610812007.text: Alright. Before we begin, there's a small magical aptitude test. Think of it as a warmup. Pass this, and you'll move on to the real thing.
choice_prompt:10:1610812007.source_cn: 好了，在正式考试之前，你们还要进行一个魔法能力测试，通过测试的同学就可以开始考试了。

say:11:1610812008:0.text: *Chuckle* Don't worry, it's nothing too demanding. We just need to confirm that everyone's basic magic is stable and ready. You've all worked so hard to get here; this is simply to make sure you can show your best selves.
say:11:1610812008:0.source_cn: 哈哈，别担心，只是一个很简单的测验，为了确定你们掌握了...
say:11:1610812008:0.male: *Chuckle* Don't worry, it's nothing too demanding. We just need to confirm that everyone's basic magic is stable and ready. You've all worked so hard to get here; this is simply to make sure you can show your best selves.
say:11:1610812008:0.female: *Chuckle* Don't worry, it's nothing too demanding. We just need to confirm that everyone's basic magic is stable and ready. You've all worked so hard to get here; this is simply to make sure you can show your best selves.

say:12:1610812009:0.text: Professor Hepler will explain the details. He's waiting just ahead.
say:12:1610812009:0.source_cn: 具体的测试内容将由赫普老师负责，他在前面等你们。

choice:10:0:1.text: Another test? Before the real one?!
choice:10:0:1.male: Another test? Before the real one?!
choice:10:0:1.female: Another test? Before the real one?!

say:1:1610813001:1.text: Everyone, keep it down. I've got news to share.
say:1:1610813001:1.source_cn: 各位，小声点，我有个消息要和大家分享。

say:3:1610813002:1.text: What's up? Did you find something?
say:3:1610813002:1.source_cn: 怎么了，格墨文，你有什么发现？

say:4:1610813003:1.text: I don't know the full details of the exam, but a friend told me it favors acting alone rather than in teams.
say:4:1610813003:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道考试的内容，但据我一位朋友所说，这场考试单独...

say:7:1610813005:1.text: Yeah. My friend who serves the prince overheard him say this test was designed for individuals.
say:7:1610813005:1.source_cn: 嗯，我那位朋友是王子的近侍，他无意中听王子殿下说这次的...

say:8:1610813006:1.text: He sent me a message last night, and I figured I should share it. At least that way it's fair.
say:8:1610813006:1.source_cn: 他昨晚派人传信，将这个消息告诉了我。我觉得应该把这个消...

say:10:1610813007:1.text: Why give away your advantage? You'd benefit more by keeping quiet.
say:10:1610813007:1.source_cn: 为什么要把这么重要的信息告诉我们？闭口不言对你更有利。

say:11:1610813008:1.text: We've all worked too hard to get here. Winning because of inside information doesn't feel right.
say:11:1610813008:1.source_cn: 我们每个人走到这一步都很不容易，不该因为这一点信息差造...

say:12:1610813009:1.text: I'm confident in my magic—I don't need this kind of edge.
say:12:1610813009:1.source_cn: 说实话，我并不算无私。但这次我和大家分享这个消息，是因...

say:13:1610813010:1.text: And besides, it goes against everything my family stands for.
say:13:1610813010:1.source_cn: 所以我不愿意用这样的信息差来为自己增加胜算，更何况，这...

say:14:1610813011:1.text: Ha! That's so like you, Gervan.
say:14:1610813011:1.source_cn: 哈，格墨文，这还真是你的作风。

say:18:1610813013:1.text: Well, if that's the case, let's split up. May the best mage stand out!
say:18:1610813013:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我们就各自行动吧。各凭本事，看看谁能从这场选...

say:19:1610813014:1.source_cn: 好，希望我们都能考试顺利！

say:21:1610813015:1.text: People begin drifting off, but Cassadee hangs back, saying she'd rather team up with you than rely on the solo advantage.
say:21:1610813015:1.source_cn: 大家纷纷独自离开，但科丝蒂却留了下来，比起所谓的“单人...
say:21:1610813015:1.male: People begin drifting off, but Cassadee hangs back, saying she'd rather team up with you than rely on the solo advantage.
say:21:1610813015:1.female: People begin drifting off, but Cassadee hangs back, saying she'd rather team up with you than rely on the solo advantage.

say:22:1610813016:1.text: You agree to partner with her and head off to find Professor Hepler.
say:22:1610813016:1.source_cn: 你答应了科丝蒂的请求，和她一起离开，准备去不远处找赫普老师。
say:22:1610813016:1.male: You agree to partner with her and head off to find Professor Hepler.
say:22:1610813016:1.female: You agree to partner with her and head off to find Professor Hepler.

say:0:1610814001:0.text: Don't go any further! I'm right here!
say:0:1610814001:0.source_cn: 别再往前走了，我在这里！

say:1:1610816001:1.text: I heard your chatter. You're right, this test will use transfiguration.
say:1:1610816001:1.source_cn: 我听到你们的讨论了，没错，这场选拔考试的确要用到变形术。

say:2:1610816002:1.text: I'm going to teach you an advanced technique that might help you during the test.
say:2:1610816002:1.source_cn: 我将教授你们一种变形术的进阶应用，你们在考试中或许能用得上。

say:3:1610816003:1.text: But before I show you this <style="highlight">new transfiguration technique</style>, I need to see where you're at skill-wise.
say:3:1610816003:1.source_cn: 但在教授你们<style=highlight>新的变形...

choice_prompt:4:1610816003.text: But before I show you this <style="highlight">new transfiguration technique</style>, I need to see where you're at skill-wise.
choice_prompt:4:1610816003.source_cn: 但在教授你们<style=highlight>新的变形术知识</style>之前，我需要先考察一下你们目前的变形术水准。

say:5:1610816004:1.text: A good candidate needs both learning ability and adaptability! Follow me.
say:5:1610816004:1.source_cn: 优秀的候选人，学习能力与应变能力一样重要！跟我来。
say:5:1610816004:1.male: A good candidate needs both learning ability and adaptability! Follow me.
say:5:1610816004:1.female: A good candidate needs both learning ability and adaptability! Follow me.

say:0:1610817001:0.text: Hmm... if I turn into a wolf, I can jump across.
say:0:1610817001:0.source_cn: 嗯……变成狼就可以跳过去了。
say:0:1610817001:0.male: Hmm... if I turn into a wolf, I can jump across.
say:0:1610817001:0.female: Hmm... if I turn into a wolf, I can jump across.

say:1:1610818001:1.text: Transfiguration tests a mage's focus like nothing else. Many graduates still shudder at the mention of it.
say:1:1610818001:1.source_cn: 变形术对施术者的魔法精神力的要求非常高，许多已经毕业的...

say:2:1610818002:1.text: But I have to say, your skills are already well beyond your classmates. Impressive.
say:2:1610818002:1.source_cn: 不过你们现在的变形术水准已经远超同阶学生，我很满意。

say:3:1610818003:1.text: So I'll teach you something special: <style="highlight">Ancestral Sense</style>. Master this, and it's like gaining a second pair of ears... or a third eye.
say:3:1610818003:1.source_cn: 因此，我会教授你们变形术中一种高深且强大的技巧：<st...

say:4:1610818004:1.text: Ancestral Sense lets you tap into deeper magical energies. Simply put, a form of necromantic perception within transfiguration that lets you sense echoes of the past.
say:4:1610818004:1.source_cn: 先祖感应，是魔法师对魔法能量的深层次应用，简单来说，这...
say:4:1610818004:1.male: Ancestral Sense lets you tap into deeper magical energies. Simply put, a form of necromantic perception within transfiguration that lets you sense echoes of the past.
say:4:1610818004:1.female: Ancestral Sense lets you tap into deeper magical energies. Simply put, a form of necromantic perception within transfiguration that lets you sense echoes of the past.

say:5:1610818005:1.text: It's like stepping from bright sunlight into a shadowy graveyard. Your senses sharpen, and you'll awaken special abilities.
say:5:1610818005:1.source_cn: 就像是从温暖的阳光下突然进入阴森的墓园，你的精神力和感...
say:5:1610818005:1.male: It's like stepping from bright sunlight into a shadowy graveyard. Your senses sharpen, and you'll awaken special abilities.
say:5:1610818005:1.female: It's like stepping from bright sunlight into a shadowy graveyard. Your senses sharpen, and you'll awaken special abilities.

choice_prompt:6:1610818005.text: It's like stepping from bright sunlight into a shadowy graveyard. Your senses sharpen, and you'll awaken special abilities.
choice_prompt:6:1610818005.source_cn: 就像是从温暖的阳光下突然进入阴森的墓园，你的精神力和感应也会突然放大，从而激活一些特殊能力。
choice_prompt:6:1610818005.male: It's like stepping from bright sunlight into a shadowy graveyard. Your senses sharpen, and you'll awaken special abilities.
choice_prompt:6:1610818005.female: It's like stepping from bright sunlight into a shadowy graveyard. Your senses sharpen, and you'll awaken special abilities.

say:7:1610818007:1.text: If you use Ancestral Sense while in <style="highlight">animal form</style>, you can detect spirits <style="highlight">within a certain range</style> that normal eyes can't see.

say:10:1610818008:1.text: Oh! I read about this in a journal! It's based on advanced theories of mental-energy tides, right?
say:10:1610818008:1.source_cn: 我想起来了，我在学术期刊里读到过，先祖感应涉及到了高深...

say:13:1610818009:1.text: Your theoretical knowledge is good, but don't forget practical application. Some of the best shapeshifters know theory but fail in execution.
say:13:1610818009:1.source_cn: 你的理论知识很扎实，但不要忘记实践，不懂理论的变形大师...

say:14:1610818010:1.text: True mastery means making magic instinctive—like a chameleon changing colors or a lizard becoming an owlbear!
say:14:1610818010:1.source_cn: 最高深的变形术就是把知识化作本能，就像变色龙会变色，蜥...

say:17:1610818011:1.text: Professor Hepler's transfiguration is second nature to him...
say:17:1610818011:1.source_cn: 赫普老师的变形术的确已经是本能了……

say:20:1610818012:1.text: Alright, let's see it in action. <style="highlight">Up ahead</style>—shift to your <style="highlight">wolf form</style>, then activate the <style="highlight">Ancestral Sense</style>. Let's see what you can find.
say:20:1610818012:1.male: Alright, let's see it in action. <style="highlight">Up ahead</style>—shift to your <style="highlight">wolf form</style>, then activate the <style="highlight">Ancestral Sense</style>. Let's see what you can find.
say:20:1610818012:1.female: Alright, let's see it in action. <style="highlight">Up ahead</style>—shift to your <style="highlight">wolf form</style>, then activate the <style="highlight">Ancestral Sense</style>. Let's see what you can find.

say:24:1610818006:1.text: That's just how Professor Hepler talks. Quirky, but effective.
say:24:1610818006:1.source_cn: 这就是赫普老师的风格，其实还挺有趣的。
say:24:1610818006:1.male: That's just how Professor Hepler talks. Quirky, but effective.
say:24:1610818006:1.female: That's just how Professor Hepler talks. Quirky, but effective.

say:0:1610819001:0.text: Remember, wolf form first, then Ancestral Sense.
say:0:1610819001:0.source_cn: 别忘了，先用变形术变成狼，再开启先祖感应。

say:0:1610820001:0.text: Excellent! You're getting the hang of this quickly.
say:0:1610820001:0.source_cn: 很不错！你们掌握得很快。
say:0:1610820001:0.male: Excellent! You're getting the hang of this quickly.
say:0:1610820001:0.female: Excellent! You're getting the hang of this quickly.

say:1:1610822001:1.text: See? That bridge was invisible before, but now it's clear as day.
say:1:1610822001:1.source_cn: 你们已经体验过了，刚才那座桥是肉眼无法看到的，但在先祖...
say:1:1610822001:1.male: See? That bridge was invisible before, but now it's clear as day.
say:1:1610822001:1.female: See? That bridge was invisible before, but now it's clear as day.

say:2:1610822002:1.text: You've got a third eye now! A second pair of ears! Another nose!
say:2:1610822002:1.source_cn: 你们拥有了第三只眼睛，第二对耳朵，第二个鼻子！
say:2:1610822002:1.male: You've got a third eye now! A second pair of ears! Another nose!
say:2:1610822002:1.female: You've got a third eye now! A second pair of ears! Another nose!

choice_prompt:3:1610822002.text: You've got a third eye now! A second pair of ears! Another nose!
choice_prompt:3:1610822002.source_cn: 你们拥有了第三只眼睛，第二对耳朵，第二个鼻子！
choice_prompt:3:1610822002.male: You've got a third eye now! A second pair of ears! Another nose!
choice_prompt:3:1610822002.female: You've got a third eye now! A second pair of ears! Another nose!

say:7:1610822005:1.text: Most secrets work the same way. They're hidden until revealed by the right method.
say:7:1610822005:1.source_cn: 许多秘密也是如此，总会暴露在特定的手段之下，无所遁形。

say:8:1610822006:1.text: Take these ruins. They look ordinary, but with Ancestral Sense, they'll show you all their secrets.
say:8:1610822006:1.source_cn: 就像这里的遗迹……肉眼是无法察觉到它的特殊之处的，但在...

say:9:1610822007:1.text: Go on, use the spell to <style="highlight">study the ruins</style> and <style="highlight">solve their mystery</style>.

say:13:1610822004:1.text: Don't worry, you'll get used to Professor Hepler. His style grows on you...
say:13:1610822004:1.source_cn: 你多和赫普老师聊聊天，习惯就好。
say:13:1610822004:1.male: Don't worry, you'll get used to Professor Hepler. His style grows on you...
say:13:1610822004:1.female: Don't worry, you'll get used to Professor Hepler. His style grows on you...

say:0:1610823001:0.text: Alright, let's see what my new "third eye" can find...
say:0:1610823001:0.source_cn: 好吧，让我看看我多出来的眼睛和耳朵能感应到什么……
say:0:1610823001:0.male: Alright, let's see what my new "third eye" can find...
say:0:1610823001:0.female: Alright, let's see what my new "third eye" can find...

say:1:1610824001:1.text: I'd say you've passed this little test with flying colors!
say:1:1610824001:1.source_cn: 我宣布，你们顺利通过了这次小测试，非常好！
say:1:1610824001:1.male: I'd say you've passed this little test with flying colors!
say:1:1610824001:1.female: I'd say you've passed this little test with flying colors!

say:4:1610824002:1.text: Professor, can we go take the main exam now?
say:4:1610824002:1.source_cn: 赫普老师，我们现在可以去参加选拔赛了吧？

say:7:1610824003:1.text: Hold on, I've got a few more things to say.
say:7:1610824003:1.source_cn: 请稍等，我还有几句话想对你们说。
say:7:1610824003:1.male: Hold on, I've got a few more things to say.
say:7:1610824003:1.female: Hold on, I've got a few more things to say.

say:8:1610824004:1.text: You're among our best students. Whatever happens in this selection, I'll be proud of you.
say:8:1610824004:1.source_cn: 你们是莱希拉姆的精英学生，无论这次选拔赛的结果如何，我...
say:8:1610824004:1.male: You're among our best students. Whatever happens in this selection, I'll be proud of you.
say:8:1610824004:1.female: You're among our best students. Whatever happens in this selection, I'll be proud of you.

say:9:1610824005:1.text: Becoming a court mage is just one path you could take. It might be the obvious one, but it's not the only choice.
say:9:1610824005:1.source_cn: 但成为宫廷魔法师，只不过是许多条路中的一条而已，或许它...
say:9:1610824005:1.male: Becoming a court mage is just one path you could take. It might be the obvious one, but it's not the only choice.
say:9:1610824005:1.female: Becoming a court mage is just one path you could take. It might be the obvious one, but it's not the only choice.

say:10:1610824006:1.text: Your futures are bigger than this. The world has far more to offer than what you see here.
say:10:1610824006:1.source_cn: 你们的未来绝非仅限于此，而世界远比你眼前所见到的更广阔。
say:10:1610824006:1.male: Your futures are bigger than this. The world has far more to offer than what you see here.
say:10:1610824006:1.female: Your futures are bigger than this. The world has far more to offer than what you see here.

say:11:1610824007:1.text: Remember: explore the world with respect, and practice magic with reverence. Whatever path you choose, carry those principles with you.
say:11:1610824007:1.source_cn: 探索世界，必先尊重世界；研究魔法，但须敬畏魔法——无论...
say:11:1610824007:1.male: Remember: explore the world with respect, and practice magic with reverence. Whatever path you choose, carry those principles with you.
say:11:1610824007:1.female: Remember: explore the world with respect, and practice magic with reverence. Whatever path you choose, carry those principles with you.

say:12:1610824008:1.text: Ahem. I can see I've lost you both. You look about as lively as two slugs in salt.
say:12:1610824008:1.source_cn: 咳，你们一定听烦了吧？你们两人的表情已经像失去了太阳的...
say:12:1610824008:1.male: Ahem. I can see I've lost you both. You look about as lively as two slugs in salt.
